div.div: أُطَيْرِقٌ and ↓ طُرَيْقٌ A sort of palm-tree of El- Hijáz, (AHn, O, K,) that is early in bearing, before the other palm-trees; the ripening and ripe dates of which are yellow: (O:) AHn also says, in one place, the اطيرق is a species of palm-trees, the earliest in bearing of all the palm-trees of El- Hijáz; and by certain of the poets such are called الطُّرَيْقُونَ and الأُطَيْرِقُونَ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
